cards.title: Five things that all point at the source today
items: Databricks auth in CI/CD, environment config, Terraform state backend, CI secrets, and branch-to-workspace mapping
Every one of them needs a target-cloud value, not a copied source value
Cloud-native identity federation (GitHub OIDC to Azure, for example) must be rebuilt for the target's federation model

cards.title: Bundles pay for themselves immediately
items: If source jobs still deploy via ad hoc scripts or manual clicks, migrate to Asset Bundles during this step
Bundle definitions are target-workspace-agnostic — only environment variables change per cloud
This decouples the deployment pipeline from the specific cloud it happens to target today

cards.title: Terraform state starts fresh
items: The target needs its own state, not source state pointing at source resource IDs
Never terraform import from source IDs into a shared state file
A cloud-storage-backed state (Azure Storage, S3, GCS) needs a new backend location for the new cloud
